name: meta_comparable_totals
purpose: Metadata-selected comparable totals for the primary value and compatible volume families.
dax:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "net revenue CURRENT", CALCULATE([net revenue CURRENT], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])),
    "net revenue PAST", CALCULATE([net revenue PAST], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])),
    "revenue Growth", CALCULATE([revenue Growth], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])),
    "net qty CURRENT", CALCULATE([net qty CURRENT], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])),
    "net qty PAST", CALCULATE([net qty PAST], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])),
    "QTY Growth", CALCULATE([QTY Growth], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])),
    "net bills CURRENT", CALCULATE([net bills CURRENT], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])),
    "transactions_prior_derived", CALCULATE([net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])),
    "bills growth", CALCULATE([bills growth], TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]))
)

name: meta_movers_by_mis_deep_dive2_special_product_group_name
purpose: Largest positive and negative comparable movements by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name].
dax:
EVALUATE
VAR ScanBase =
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name],
        TREATAS({"ST4", "ST1", "ST3", "ST2", "ST5"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "transactions_prior_derived", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
        "bills growth", [bills growth]
    )
RETURN
DISTINCT(
    UNION(
        TOPN(7, ScanBase, [revenue Growth], DESC),
        TOPN(7, ScanBase, [revenue Growth], ASC)
    )
)
ORDER BY [revenue Growth] DESC
